title: ROSE Doesn’t Do That: Boosting the Safety of Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models with Reverse Prompt Contrastive Decoding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot accuracy on the Unfairness and Bias (UB) subset of the SafetyBench multiple-choice benchmark.

Generating responses to harmful questions from the DangerousQA dataset (which specifically covers racist, sexist, and stereotypical prompts) and evaluating the harmfulness and refusal rates using an LLM-as-a-judge (ChatGPT).
